en-US.title: Aria: Offline Study Tutor
en-US.subtitle: Offline tutor with a library
en-US.description:
Aria is a study tutor that works on your iPhone and iPad with no internet and no account. It is built around a reference library that lives on your device, so its answers are grounded in real entries you can read and check, not just generated text. Everything happens on your device; nothing you ask or photograph is sent to a server.

AN OFFLINE LIBRARY, NOT JUST A CHATBOT
Aria carries its own reference shelf and reads from it before it answers:
• A handbook of more than 1,300 formulas, rules and facts across math and science, history, English and geography.
• An optional free library of about 79,000 encyclopedia articles and an 86,000-word dictionary (a 75 MB one-time download).
Search any of it directly in the Library tab, and when Aria answers a question it shows which entries it used so you can open and read the source.

FLASHCARDS
Turn the handbook into self-test rounds. Pick a subject, get 20 cards, flip each one, mark what you know, and see your score. It all runs offline.

WORKSHEETS AND PAGES
Take a photo of a printed worksheet or a page from a book. Aria reads the text on your device and works through the questions it finds, step by step.

BUILT FOR STUDYING
• Explanations of topics and books, at the depth you ask for
• Step-by-step working for math and science homework
• Quiz me: one question at a time, then your score
• A built-in calculator checks the arithmetic, so numbers are not guessed
• Help with essays, emails and messages
• Follow-up buttons such as "Explain it more simply" and "Give me an example"
• Notes keep their own memory, so Aria follows a single study session without mixing in another

YOUR CHOICE OF BRAIN
The Models page lets you download any of twelve on-device models, from small and fast to large and knowledgeable, including Qwen3, Google Gemma 4, Microsoft Phi-4 mini, Meta Llama 3.2, Liquid LFM2.5 and SmolLM2. Automatic picks the best one your device can run, or lock a note to a specific model.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no tracking, no ads. Your notes, photos and flashcard scores stay on your device.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The first launch downloads a model once (about 1.5 GB for the default). Use Wi-Fi. After that Aria works offline.
• Larger models need a recent device with 6 GB of memory or more.
• On-device models are smaller than cloud AI, so check anything important against the library or another source.

review.notes:
Aria runs its AI models on the device. No account, no sign-in, so no demo account is needed.

ABOUT THE 4.3 REJECTION OF THE PREVIOUS BUILD: the app has been reworked so it is not another generic offline chatbot. Aria is a study tutor built around a reference library stored on the device. Distinct functionality a plain chat app does not have:
- A bundled, searchable reference library: a 1,300-entry handbook, an optional 79,000-article encyclopedia and an 86,000-word dictionary (Library tab > Search). Answers cite the library entries they used, which you can open and read.
- Flashcards generated from the handbook, with scoring (Library tab > Flashcards).
- Worksheet/page solving from a photo, read on the device (camera or + in the Ask tab).
- A built-in calculator that verifies arithmetic.
- Quiz mode and step-by-step homework.
- A model manager with twelve selectable on-device models and per-note model choice.
The interface, source code and assets are our own, not a template.

FIRST LAUNCH downloads the default model once (about 1.5 GB, from Hugging Face). Please use Wi-Fi and allow a few minutes; a progress ring is shown. After that the app works offline, stepping down to a smaller model automatically if memory is tight.

WHAT TO TRY: (1) Ask tab, type a question; tap Deep think for step-by-step reasoning. (2) Camera/+ to read a printed page (a small text-recognition model, ~100 MB, downloads the first time). (3) Library tab > Search the handbook; the fuller library (~75 MB, public-domain and openly licensed reference text on GitHub) is optional. (4) Library tab > Flashcards for self-test rounds. (5) Model button > Get more models.

PRIVACY: the app collects no data. Network use is limited to downloading model and library files and checking for app updates.

If this version is still considered too similar to another app, we would be grateful to know which one so we can differentiate further.
